name: Generic Identification 11
definition: Information related to an identification, eg, party identification or account identification.

Identification.name: Identification
Identification.definition: Name or number assigned by an entity to enable recognition of that entity, eg, account identifier.

IdentificationType.name: Identification Type
IdentificationType.definition: Specifies the nature of the identifier.

ExtendedIdentificationType.name: Extended Identification Type
ExtendedIdentificationType.definition: Specifies a type of individual identification.

IdentificationTypeOrExtendedIdentificati.definition: Either IdentificationType or ExtendedIdentificationType must be present, but not both.
